notes: הוּא is left unrepresented and the copula given to the nominal predicate under rule 20's tripartite ruling; giving *was* to the pronoun was the competing reading.
The first infinitive's written *to* belongs to its לְ (rule 52); the second infinitive has no preposition before it, so its *to* is the infinitive's own (rule 52, closing).
The cohortative he is unrepresented (rule 32); גַּם takes the postposed *also*, discontinuous under rule 25.
